commands:
xcodebuild build-for-testing -project ios/build/VoxelOne.xcodeproj -scheme VoxelOne \
  -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,id=$udid" \
  -derivedDataPath ios/build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
  > ios/build/native-build.log 2>&1

xcodebuild test-without-building -project ios/build/VoxelOne.xcodeproj -scheme VoxelOne \
  -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,id=$udid" -derivedDataPath ios/build/DerivedData \
  -parallel-testing-enabled NO -maximum-concurrent-test-simulator-destinations 1 \
  -resultBundlePath ios/build/NativeTests.xcresult CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
  > ios/build/native-tests.log 2>&1

Playtest.workflow: Installed UIKit/SceneKit client: offline break/place, hold movement, drag look, jump and land, pause, save/resume/cold restart, landscape; online city login, select/undo road points, server confirmation and road count increase, walk, logout/reconnect.
Playtest.edge: Empty hotbar slot rejects placing; city confirm rejects fewer than two road points.
Playtest.regression: Collision/jump/ray/edit rules, invalid/duplicate snapshot rejection and save round trip.
Playtest.expected: All four native test cases pass on the assigned fresh simulator; independent app launch renders saved world and touch controls.
Playtest.observed: All four passed; inspected client image shows sky/grass horizon, player position, touch controls and edited Dirt inventory count 31.

media.description: Actual independent native app launch; inspected. Saved sandbox world and controls. No account forms.
Simulator home screen only; environment evidence, not gameplay.

audit.notes: Native client, loopback gateway, synthetic integration checks, simulator harness/docs and task evidence comprise the proposed change. No unrelated deletions. Prior generated root upload staging moved into ignored target storage.

limits: Simulator pass is not a physical iPhone test.
Device signing and install follow ios/BUILDING.txt.
Online access needs the documented HTTPS reverse proxy; offline world is a saved 49x49 terrain patch; desktop advanced editors and fractional blocks remain outside this client.
